messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PAGER fired for service=infra-inference-gateway (high 5xx rate, threshold breached) — incident id: PD-3312
Jordan (oncall): acked — looking
Jordan (oncall): seeing a big spike in 5xx from gateway->model-backends in us-east1, ~40% 5xx over last 5m. dashboards.redwood/inference/gateway?range=5m
Sam (sre): I can see increased latency and connection resets on the long-lived model streams. traces show timeouts to model-sheduler-us-east. link: https://observability/redwood/trace/abc123
Lee (eng-prod): any recent deploys to scheduler or model nodes in us-east? I don't see infra deploys, but model pool autoscaler did a scale event 03:18UTC. Could be saturation from a bad traffic pattern.
Jordan (oncall): no manual deploys. traffic pattern shows a sudden bump of long-context requests (seq>6k) — probable KV/cache pressure.
Natalie (support): Customer C reported latency errors around 03:20. Tickets coming in. High priority customers flagged.
Sam (sre): quick mitigation suggestions: 1) temporarily route production traffic for the public API to fallback model-variant (light) 2) reduce max-concurrent streams per backend 3) warm small pool.
Lee (eng-prod): I'm leaning to (1) + (3). We can flip routing at the control plane. Plan: set routing policy for `public/text-generation` to prefer model-variant=redwood-small with fallback back to redwood-large only if <10% traffic. That should reduce backend load.
Jordan (oncall): I'll run the control-plane change and watch metrics. Pasting curl to runbook:

```
# route change: set weight for small variant
curl -X POST \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  https://controlplane.redwood/api/v1/routing/update \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","policy":{"variant_weights":{"redwood-small":0.9,"redwood-large":0.1}}}'
```

Sam (sre): also lower backend concurrency on the scheduler pool to 8 (was 24). API: `PATCH /admin/pools/us-east/scheduler` body `{max_concurrency:8}`
Jordan (oncall): executing routing change now. `runbook:route-change`
Jordan (oncall): done — route updated. metrics: 5xx dropping from 42% -> 18% in ~90s
Lee (eng-prod): good. warming small pool now. spawning 10 instances of redwood-small in us-east.
Sam (sre): reducing scheduler concurrency now. monitoring for increased queueing.
Jordan (oncall): 5xx at 9m window now 6% and falling. p50 latency for gateway down to baseline ~85ms from 320ms.
Natalie (support): updated Customer C Slack thread: "we're seeing improvements, will continue to monitor, will follow up in 30m" :white_check_mark:
Lee (eng-prod): can we make the routing change a temporary canary with 15m TTL and automatic rollback if 5xx < 1%? safer.
Jordan (oncall): set TTL to 30m in control plane and enable rollback condition `5xx_rate < 1% for 5m` — done.
Sam (sre): need postmortem owner? I can take incident triage and lead RCA with eng-prod.
Lee (eng-prod): assigning to Sam + Lee. tags: kvcache-pressure, model-autoscale, routing-fallback
pagerduty-bot: PD incident PD-3312 acknowledged by Jordan; escalation suppressed. PD notes updated.
Jordan (oncall): final check: spike subsided, customer impact reduced. leaving an action item: create automation to detect long-context KPIs and proactively spin warm pool for redwood-small.
Natalie (support): I'll send a customer status update and ask for any residual error samples.
Sam (sre): thanks all. will open postmortem doc and link traces + runbook commands. If anyone sees resurgence ping here.
Lee (eng-prod): quick follow-up: add small-variant warmup in Optimize suggestions (ticket created: OPT-849).
Jordan (oncall): handing off to next shift at 04:00 UTC — watchlist set. :v:
